HOW TO PLAY

THE RUN

Move forward through an endless kitchen. The camera advances behind you, so falling behind is dangerous. You begin every run with 3 hearts; the third damaging hit ends the run.

LANES

PREPSafe rest lane and food.
PANTRYDodge Wicked Bite creatures and bombs.
CANALRide food platforms—or fly as Gully.
EXPRESSRespect the warning. No character gets a free pass.

SCORE & CANDY

Eat good food, maintain combos, cross dangerous lanes and take calculated near-misses. Golden Food grants a temporary power. Rare Hearts restore one missing life.

ABILITIES

Space / Shift, gamepad A, or the on-screen Ability button uses the selected character's power. Abilities create alternate strategies, but every generated route remains beatable by Classic without using one.

BANKING

Pause and choose Bank Run to keep the Candy and best distance earned so far instead of risking the rest of the run.
